description: This file implements utility functions for handling inotify events, specifically for retrieving a list of created files based on inotify file descriptor events.

methods.name: GetCreatedFileListFromInotifyFd
methods.description: Returns a list of filenames for created files by calling GetFileListFromInotifyFd with the IN_CREATE mask.

methods.name: GetFileListFromInotifyFd
methods.description: Reads inotify events from a file descriptor and returns a list of filenames for events matching the specified mask.
